events.title: Demo update 0.9.6.3
events.summary: Demo update 0.9.6.3 — the factory now tells you what's wrongThe first days of the demo taught me one thing very clearly: the game knew why you were stuck, and kept it to itself. Several players sat watching an accepted order go nowhere, with no idea why. This update fixes the silence, not the difficulty. events.title: BOTTLECAPEPRS DEMO IS OUT NOW
events.summary: Hi Bottlecappers,I've been working on this game for a while now, in the evenings and on weekends whenever I can. I think the best way to explain what kind of game it is, and whether you might like it, is simply to let you play it. So the demo is out.The demo lets you play a full, winnable run. The only real limitation is that you play with one investor, the first one: the Cortesu Family.
